graph.title: Shuff (LEGO Mixels 41505)
notes: The booklet only shows pictures, and several steps (4-15) are small and ambiguous, so I matched pieces to the official inventory counts. Which piece goes in which of those steps is a best guess.
The body steps 1-8, 10-15 and the 3003, 3022, 3023, 99207 and 14704 placements are inferred. Counts match the parts list exactly (51 pieces).
Ports are left null where the exact stud/anti-stud position could not be read from the pictures.
Eyes (lego-32474pr1001) are assumed to sit on the bottom pins of the two 3040b slopes on the head (pin into axle-hole). Arms clip onto the two body clip plates b5 and b22 (clip/bar).
The legs are shown as two separate sub-assemblies (pages 11 and 13) that are mirrored, so they are not in a repeat. Each leg ball (15456) snaps into one of the two 14704 ball sockets on the body.
The six-way bottom piece 2654 and the 87580 jumper plus the Pearl Gold crystal are placed on steps 19-20 as drawn. The 87580 is not shown in its own parts box, so its position is inferred.
The connector servers (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) listed in the session need authorization in claude.ai connector settings. They were not used for this task.
